text: Verbatim, printed pp. 7 and 17: the study's "findings and conclusions were presented in a clear, comprehensive, and timely manner". Printed p. 18 records the timeline: a contract in October 2012, preliminary results to the Army in April 2013, interim briefings to key congressional committees later in 2013, and a final report to those committees in April 2014.
